decisions.reviewer: Codex root actual five-view material correction review

front.note: The broad cap now has quiet grain-aligned reflection; the recessed brick firebox and guard remain legible.

rear.note: Rear cap and uprights meet the casing cleanly; no repeated checker highlight remains.

detail.note: Full-resolution detail confirms the waffle artifact is removed, retaining layered bricks, grate, log ends and brass fixings.

underside.note: Continuous dark plinth and attached guard supports remain joined under the recessed firebox.

clay.note: Clay shows separated masonry, logs and guard with eased surround edges; flames retain the authored stylized geometry.

decisions.reviewer: Codex root actual five-view material correction review

front.note: Three staggered canisters and timber lids read correctly, but the cylindrical bodies have coarse visible faceting.

rear.note: The rear body reflections repeat hard radial bands and need a smoother turned silhouette.

detail.note: Oak grain is correctly visible on the lids; the bodies remain noticeably polygonal at close range.

underside.note: Dark open-looking bottom circles require a source inspection for actual base closure before acceptance.

clay.note: Clay confirms low radial segmentation in the walls; improve body construction rather than accepting only the lid maps.

decisions.reviewer: Codex root actual five-view material correction review

front.note: Splayed legs, bowl and grate form a coherent fire pit; broad facets interrupt the curved steel basin.

rear.note: The rear bowl wall has visible angular panel-like facets despite being a spun basin.

detail.note: Timber grain and separated grate bars are clear, while the basin rim and interior need radial refinement.

underside.note: Three leg attachments and the bottom opening detail remain recognizable; preserve those supports when refining the basin.

clay.note: Clay exposes the low-segment bowl silhouette; request a smoother turned shell within the current dimensions.

decisions.reviewer: Codex root actual five-view material correction review

front.note: Slender timber tripod supports an open tapered linen shade with a balanced floor-lamp silhouette.

rear.note: The three splayed legs remain distinct and the circular brace connects them at consistent height.

detail.note: Close view reveals timber grain and the small brace fasteners; the shade remains softly matte.

underside.note: The shade is open below and the narrow uprights continue into it without detached components.

clay.note: Clay retains the thin shade wall, three supports and round brace; sparse construction suits this lamp design.

decisions.reviewer: Codex root actual five-view material correction review

front.note: Open white vessel and timber handles are clear, but five identical blunt heads look like duplicated sticks.

rear.note: The reverse view repeats the same rectangular utensils and faceted vessel wall.

detail.note: Scanned wood grain is visible; head shape variety and a smoother crock are needed for convincing construction.

underside.note: The vessel has a dark base and supported handles; verify base closure while improving the cylindrical wall.

clay.note: Clay makes the identical paddle geometry obvious; replace selected heads with distinct spoon and slotted utensil forms.
